SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 136
Date

NICHI- NICHI

ITALIAN MOTOR CAR RUNS OVER JAPANESE MARINES

At 10 p.m. February 25 a motor
car occupied by an Italian named Fra. ces G. Zapino,
residing at No. 566 Dixwell Road and his wife while
proceeding at 50 miles an hour in westerly direction on
Yangtzepoo road near 'Foo Tan'Road (?) struck from behind
3 Japanese marines of a patrol party.
The injured marines are named
Kimura, Amitani and Kobayashi. Kobayashi received injuries
in the face; Amitani was dragged along a distance of about
50 feet causing injuries to his body; Kimura was dragged
230 feet causing a fracture of the skull and profuse bleeding-
his condition is grave. The injured men were immediately
removed to the Japanese marine hospital.
The Italian was taken to Yulin
Road Police Station. The fact that Kimura was dragged
xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx a distance of 230 feet by the
motor car clearly indicates the intention of the Italian
to make his escape after the incident.
The Japanese marine authorities
are making further investigations and will lodge a strong
protest with the Italian Consulate through the Japanese
Consulate.

M. ILICHI

JAPANESE MARINES INJURED BY ITALIAN MOTOR CAR
ACCIDENT.

An Italian named Francis Joseph
who caused injuries to 3 Japanese marines in
a motor car accident on February 25, 1933, on Yangtzepoo
Road, has been sentenced to 3 months and 16 days
imprisonment by the Italian Consular Court. The sentence
was passed in the presence of several Japanese marine
officers. The Consular Court issued an order suspending
the sentence for 5 years.

ITALIAN SENTENCED TO 3 MONTHS IMPRISONMENT

An Italian named Francis Jovino
who caused injuries to the Japanese marines as the result
of a motor car accident, was sentenced to 3 months and 16
days imprisonment.
A civil case for $19,700 compensa-
tion is being lodged soon against the Italian Jovino.

《日日新闻》

意大利汽车撞伤日本海军陆战队员

2月25日晚10时，一辆由居住在狄思威路566号的意大利人弗拉切斯·G·扎皮诺（Fra. ces G. Zapino）及其妻子乘坐的汽车，在杨树浦路靠近“复旦”路（？）处以每小时50英里的速度向西行驶时，从后方撞击了一支巡逻队中的3名日本海军陆战队员。
受伤的海军陆战队员姓名为木村（Kimura）、味谷（Amitani）和小林（Kobayashi）。小林面部受伤；味谷被拖行约50英尺，身体受伤；木村被拖行230英尺，导致头骨骨折和大出血，情况危急。伤者随即被送往日本海军医院。
该意大利人被带往榆林路捕房。木村被汽车拖行xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 230英尺这一事实，清楚地表明该意大利人在事发后意图逃逸。
日本海军当局正在进行进一步调查，并将通过日本领事馆向意大利领事馆提出强烈抗议。

M. ILICHI

日本海军陆战队员被意大利汽车撞伤事故。

一名名叫弗朗西斯·约瑟夫（Francis Joseph）的意大利人，在1933年2月25日于杨树浦路发生的汽车事故中致使3名日本海军陆战队员受伤，已被意大利领事法庭判处监禁3个月零16天。宣判时有数名日本海军军官在场。领事法庭发布命令，缓刑5年执行。

意大利人被判监禁3个月

一名名叫弗朗西斯·乔维诺（Francis Jovino）的意大利人，因汽车事故导致日本海军陆战队员受伤，被判处监禁3个月零16天。
针对意大利人乔维诺的19,700美元民事赔偿诉讼即将提起。

With reference to your letter No.1021 of January 16,
1933, L.F. Jovino is a shady character who has come to the
notice of the Police on several occasions in consequence
of his connection with the illicit traffic in arms and
opium. He was charged at the Italian Court on June 18,
1927 with aiding and abetting in the sale of arms and was
sentenced to 75 days' imprisonment. He was at the same
Court on December 12,1923, sentenced to two months'

on that occasion. Jovino was cautioned on a charge of
Disorderly Conduct and Assault at the Italian Court on
May 10,1920.

It is said that Jovino was recently connected in
some way with the Macao Greyhound Racing Company.

Jovino is a Eurasian, his father being an Italian
and his mother Chinese, and he is married to a Chinese
wife.

REPORT
Date January 19. 19 33 .

Subject (in full) Report on L. F. Jovino.

Made by D.S. Tilton Forwarded by （签名）

Enquiries indicate that Mr. L. F. Jovino, aged 42, Italian,
of 566 Dixwell Road, is well known to the Municipal Police as a
notorious character concerned in such shady enterprises as
gun-running, trafficking in arms and ammunition, and also opium.
He first came under particular notice on May 30, 1920, charged
with "Disorderly Conduct with Assault" receiving a caution.
On December 12, 1923, he was charged with a further offence, "
Possession of Raw Opium", and received a suspended sentence of
two months imprisonment and fined 1000 lire. On June 18, 1927,
he was concerned in a more serious offence and charged with
"Aiding and Abetting in Sale of Arms", and sentenced to 75 days from
date of arrest. His two confederates in this case, namely,
Samuel Chaiet, American, a notorious gunrunner, and William W.
Worthington, American lawyer, were both found guilty of trafficking
in arms at the American Consular Court on July 22, 1927 and
each fined U.S.$300.
Of late years Jovino is stated to have been connected
with the "Macao Greyhound Racing Company", which closed down
recently owing to financial difficulties.

（签名）
D. S.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

调查显示，L. F. 乔维诺先生，42岁，意大利人，住狄思威路566号，为工部局警务处所熟知，是一名从事军火走私、军火弹药交易以及鸦片等可疑活动的 notorious 人物。他首次受到特别注意是在1920年5月30日，因“行为不检并袭击”受指控，受到警告。1923年12月12日，他再次因“持有生鸦片”罪名受指控，被判监禁两个月（缓期执行）并罚款1000里拉。1927年6月18日，他卷入一起更严重的罪行，被控“协助和销售军火”，自逮捕之日起被判监禁75天。此案中的两名同伙，即美国著名军火走私贩塞缪尔·蔡特（Samuel Chaiet）和美国律师威廉·W·沃辛顿（William W. Worthington），均于1927年7月22日在美国领事法庭被判犯有军火交易罪，各罚款300美元。
近年来，据称乔维诺与“澳门赛狗公司”有关联，该公司近期因财务困难而停业。

（签名）
D. S.
特别分部主管警官。

I shall be glad if you will supply me with a
confidential report as to the activities of Mr. L. F.

For several years Mr. Jovino has consistently
refused to pay the Special Rate, and I have given instruc-
tions that no motor car licence for the Settlement be
issued to him.

Applications to the Italian Court, so far from
being helpful, seem to suggest that he has some particular
influence with the Italian Consular authorities.

Subject (in full) Commercial Intelligence Bureau.

Made by D. I. Robertson. Forwarded by Hrs Robertson D. I.

With reference to the attached circular, The
Commercial Intelligence Bureau, 19 Kiukiang Road, was established
some time in January 1929. The sole partners are Mr. V. Beatty,
lately A.C. (Sikhs) and Mr. Sammy Chaiet. Mr. Maitland, lately
Prosecuting Solicitor, acts as legal adviser. Up to the
present the company has been very successful and among other
work have secured contracts with the Canadian Pacific Railway
Coy., the Glen Line Eastern Agencies Ltd., the Java-China-Japan
Line and the East Asiatic Co., Ltd. to prevent pilferage of
cargo on the said companies wharves and godowns. They have
also been given commissions by the British Cigarette Coy and
the British American Tobacco Company to detect thieving among
the employees of the latter concerns. In addition to this they
have been given debts amounting in the aggregate to $93.000.00
to collect for various firms.

It seems to be the intention of the company to
maintain a high standard of business efficiency and methods
and it is said that they will not undertake inquiries into
divorce cases or other domestic differences much to the
disappointment of some of the local lawyers, who specialize in those
cases.

关于附函，九江路19号的商业情报局成立于1929年1月的某个时候。唯一合伙人为 V. 比蒂先生（前锡克教团副督察）和萨米·蔡特先生。梅特兰先生（前公诉律师）担任法律顾问。截至目前，该公司非常成功，除其他业务外，还获得了与加拿大太平洋铁路公司、格兰轮船公司东方代理有限公司、爪哇-中国-日本航线以及东亚有限公司的合同，以防止在上述公司的码头和仓库发生货物盗窃事件。他们还受英国卷烟公司和英美烟草公司委托，侦测后者雇员中的盗窃行为。此外，他们还受托为各家公司追讨总计达93,000.00美元的债务。

C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 126
Date..........Mch. 3. 19

Commercial Intelligence Bureau
19 Kiujiang Road
Shanghai, China.

Dear Sir,
For some considerable time the majority of the larger Foreign and Chinese firms in Shanghai and the outports have felt the need for a Bureau which will be prepared to undertake investigations and supply confidential reports on other firms with whom business transactions are contemplated.
To that end, an organisation styling itself the Commercial Intelligence Bureau has been formed. Those responsible for its inception have, during the past year, been occupied in investigating the stability of business concerns and individuals, both in Shanghai and other parts of the country. Prior to this, they have all for many years been in close touch with commerce and/or professional enquiry work. They are therefore confident that they are in a position to fulfil the requirements of business men both here and elsewhere.
Further, the Commercial Intelligence Bureau, having correspondants in all ports and trading centres of the world, is in a position to supply local merchants with information regarding other cities when required.
The organisation is composed of a group of foreign and Chinese managers, and a detective staff, the latter reporting specially on the dealings and standing of Chinese merchants. Naturally, in order that they may consistently obtain accurate information, it is essential that the names should not be divulged
A fixed charge of $ 10 is made for each ordinary enquiry.
It might, in passing, be mentioned that the Commercial Intelligence Bureau is prepared to keep on record copies of Companies' Articles of Association or partnership particulars—should same be deposited. These would be open for inspection to other firms wishing to trade with them and to verify their bona-fides.
Enquiries as to the whereabouts of absconding dealers are also undertaken. If traced their financial status will, upon request, be investigated, and if necessary claims against them will be dealt with by the Bureau's Legal Adviser.

Your faithfully

Commercial Intelligence Bureau

编号 I. O. D. 126
日期..........19__年3月3日。

商业情报局
中国上海九江路19号

尊敬的先生：
相当长一段时间以来，上海及外埠的大多数大型外商和华商公司都感到需要有一个机构，愿意承担调查任务，并就拟进行商业交易的其他公司提供机密报告。
为此，一个自称“商业情报局”的组织已经成立。负责发起该组织的人员在过去一年中，一直致力于调查上海及全国其他地区企业和个人的稳定性。在此之前，他们多年来都与商业和/或专业调查工作保持着密切联系。因此，他们有信心能够满足这里及其他地方商界人士的需求。
此外，商业情报局在世界所有港口和贸易中心均有通讯员，能够在需要时向本地商人提供有关其他城市的信息。
该组织由一群外籍和华人经理以及侦探人员组成，后者专门报告华商的交易和信誉情况。当然，为了确保持续获得准确信息，必须保密姓名。
每次普通调查收取固定费用10美元。
顺便提一下，商业情报局愿意存档公司章程或合伙细节的副本——如果存入的话。这些文件将开放给希望与其交易并验证其真实性的其他公司查阅。
本局也承接查找潜逃商人下落的调查。如果找到，经请求将调查其财务状况，如有必要，本局法律顾问将处理针对他们的索赔事宜。

您忠实的

商业情报局

Subject (in full) Sammy Chaiet.

Made by D. I. Robertson Forwarded by M. Swins A. S. V. L.

Inquiries go to show that since July 22, 1927,
when he was convicted in the American Court on charges of
dealing in arms and ammunition, until about the middle of
November Sammy Chaiet has maintained himself on the proceeds
of casual employment such as Intelligence work for the American
Consulate and other odd jobs given him by different members
of the American community with whom he is very popular. In
the beginning of December 1928 he was given employment in one
of the administration offices attached to Dr. J.T. Yang's
apartment. About the end of December last he is reported
to have joined Mr. W. Beatty, lately A. J. (Sicks) and Mr. E. T.
Maitland, lately Prosecuting Solicitor, in a form of partnership
and to have established an office inside the flat occupied by
Frazar & Co., Ltd., at 19 Kiukiang Road. It is reported that
this combination is endeavouring to work up connections as
an information bureau in giving advice to wealthy Chinese on
anti-kidnapping and to various shipping companies on measures
against pilferage on wharves. In this last proposition they
are supported by a Chinese named Tang of Arnold & Co. Ltd.,
and by K. E. Yang, the Compradore of the Dutch Bank, 11 Kiukiang
Road. Chaiet's duties are somewhat varied, but it may be
said that he conducts enquiries for Mr. Beatty in finding out
the standing of Frazar & Co's bad creditors and their ability
to pay, which has enabled Mr. Beatty to collect several of that
firm's bad debts on princely commission, sometimes as much as
50%.

Chaiet resides at 3 Ezra Road.

A/D.C.I.
(印：COMMISSIONER OF POLICE SHANGHAI FEB 4 1929)
M. Robertson 8/2/29
D. I.

刑事侦缉处登记室
编号 I. O. 9686。
中央情报局
日期 19

主题（全称）Sammy Chaiet。

由 D. I. Robertson 制作，经 M. Swins A. S. V. L. 转呈。

调查显示，自1927年7月22日他因非法买卖军火弹药在美国法院被判有罪以来，直到11月中旬左右，Sammy Chaiet 一直依靠零星工作的收入维持生计，例如为美国领事馆从事情报工作，以及美国侨民社区中与他关系甚笃的不同成员交给他的其他杂务。1928年12月初，他在杨医生（Dr. J.T. Yang）寓所附属的一间行政办公室获得了一份工作。据报，在去年12月底，他与最近担任助理法官（Sicks）的 W. Beatty 先生和最近担任公诉律师的 E. T. Maitland 先生结成某种合伙关系，并在九江路19号弗拉泽有限公司（Frazar & Co., Ltd.）所占用的公寓内设立了一间办公室。据报，该组合正努力建立联系，作为一个信息局，向富裕华人提供反绑架建议，并向各家轮船公司提供防止码头盗窃的措施建议。在后一项提议中，他们得到了阿诺德有限公司（Arnold & Co. Ltd.）的一位姓唐的华人和九江路11号荷兰银行买办杨格非（K. E. Yang）的支持。Chaiet 的职责颇为多样，但可以说，他为 Beatty 先生进行调查，查明弗拉泽有限公司不良债权人的资信状况及其偿付能力，这使得 Beatty 先生能够以丰厚的佣金收回该公司的几笔坏账，有时高达50%。

Chaiet 居住在爱多亚路3号。

助理刑事侦缉督察
（印：上海警务处处长 1929年2月4日）
M. Robertson 1929年2月8日
侦探督察

November 7, 8

Dear Goldsmith,

With reference to your letter No. G.S.I. (B)/214
dated October 12 regarding the [████████████████] of
October 10, enquiries indicate that personalities, etc.,
mentioned are the following:-

1. "Telegraph" is the nickname of a Chinese on the staff of
the Central Bank of China, No. 15 The Bund. Enquiries
failed to ascertain the persons identity definitely,
but it is suspected to be Li Chow (李冀 ), the Chief of
the Issuing Department of the Central Bank of China.

2. The man who was in the American Intelligence Service is
Samuel Chaiet, an American citizen who is well known to
the Municipal Police as a notorious gunrunner. He was
arrested by the Municipal Police on June 6, 1927 together
with an American lawyer, William W. Worthington and an
Italian, A.F. Jovino, for trafficking in arms and
ammunition. The first two mentioned appeared before
the American Consular Court and after a series of
protracted hearings were found guilty on July 22, 1927,
when both of them were fined U.S. $300 each.

3. With regard to Loi Zhong's wireless set, enquiries
indicate that it is located in the Central Bank of China,
No. 15 The Bund. Despite diligent enquiries, however,
the investigations failed to ascertain the system in use,
the wave length of the set and other particulars.

Copies to Capt. J. Shellen. u

1948年11月7日）
11月7日、8日

亲爱的 Goldsmith：

关于你方10月12日发出的第 G.S.I. (B)/214 号信函，提及10月10日的 [████████████████]，调查显示，所提及的人物等如下：-

1. “Telegraph”是中国银行（外滩15号）一名华籍职员的绰号。调查未能确切查明该人的身份，但怀疑是中国银行发行局局长李冀（Li Chow）。

2. 曾在美国情报部门工作的人是 Samuel Chaiet，一名美国公民，工部局警务处对其作为臭名昭著的军火走私贩十分熟悉。他于1927年6月6日被工部局警务处逮捕，同案被捕的还有美国律师 William W. Worthington 和意大利人 A.F. Jovino，罪名是非法买卖军火弹药。上述前两人出庭受审于美国领事法庭，经过一系列漫长的听证后，于1927年7月22日被判有罪，两人各被罚款300美元。

3. 关于 Loi Zhong 的无线电台，调查显示其位于外滩15号的中国银行内。然而，尽管进行了勤勉的调查，仍未能查明所使用的系统、电台波长及其他细节。

抄送 J. Shellen 上尉。u

Sir,

Mr. Tseng Lai 鄭萊 better known as Loi
Chong is a Cantonese, returned student from
America. He was at one time Director of the
Bank of China, Hongkong. He is now
connected with the Ministry of Finance
Banking, with the Kerosene Oil Tax Bureau and
the Wine and Tobacco Tax Office.

He visits frequently the Preparatory
Office of the Central Bank of China, No.15
the Bund but he resides at 45A Jessfield Road.

It is strongly suspected that he is keeping
a wireless set at his residence but enquiries
amongst his friends have failed to confirm this.

Sam Sharland
Clerical Assistant.

D.G.I. ACP (Pol)

先生，

郑莱（Tseng Lai），更广为人知的名字是 Loi Chong，广东人，留美归国学生。他曾任中国银行香港分行董事。目前他与财政部银行业、煤油税局以及烟酒税局有关联。
